status: Owner adopted the recommended encounter/streaming approach and Chrono Trigger / Sea of Stars transition direction; detailed contracts and runtime evidence remain pending
supersedes: Adoption status of TIME-P01 and STREAM-P01 in v0.4; previous requirements remain inherited except for the explicit overrides below

overrides.requirement: Use seamless block/grid streaming for continuous wilderness and vehicle travel, with predictive loading and separate detailed/coarse simulation. Preserve deterministic identity, mutations, vehicles, cargo, people, relationships and quests across loading boundaries.
overrides.status: Owner-adopted direction; exact budgets and vehicle-specific contracts remain to be specified

overrides.requirement: Use bounded on-field encounters with full Wait decision holds, deterministic shared authority, controlled admission of outside influences and safe exit/re-entry. Retain shared world pause for solo and coordinated play. Independent cooperative exploration explicitly distinguishes tactical progress from outside world time.
overrides.status: Owner-adopted direction; calendar, environmental dependency, merge and inactivity contracts still require closure

additions.requirement: Make exploration-to-combat and combat-to-exploration transitions in the mould of Chrono Trigger and Sea of Stars: retain the same field and entities, use brief expressive staging and coherent camera/UI/audio changes, preserve legal positions and persistent aftermath, and resume exploration without a replacement arena or routine loading transition.
additions.status: Owner-selected presentation direction; native animation and runtime acceptance pending

adopted_proposals.status: Adopted as design direction, including the seven v0.4 encounter principles; not implemented
